announcement.goals.noellesroles.jester: Find and co-operate with the Killers.
announcement.goals.noellesroles.morphlin: Frame others by disguising as them.
announcement.goals.noellesroles.conducto: Use your master keys to access any door.
announcement.role.noellesroles.the_insan: The Insane Damned Paranoid Killer Of Doom Death Destruction And Waffles
announcement.goals.noellesroles.bartende: See players that drink through walls and poisoned trays.
announcement.goals.noellesroles.phantom: Turn invisible. Watch out when holding out items or collision.
announcement.goals.noellesroles.noisemak: Alert players of your location upon your death.
announcement.goals.noellesroles.conspira: Conspire with the Killers against the other Passengers.
announcement.goals.noellesroles.voodoo: Briefly track the movement of other passengers.
announcement.goals.noellesroles.executio: Become a killer once your target dies (to a non-killer).
announcement.goals.noellesroles.trapper: Trap a group of people to find their role.
announcement.goals.noellesroles.recaller: Teleport to anywhere on the train!
announcement.goals.noellesroles.guesser: Guess civilian's roles to kill them instantly!
announcement.goals.noellesroles.mimic: You look like a killer cohort to other killers!
announcement.goals.noellesroles.vulture: Eat bodies to turn into a killer.
item.noellesroles.defense_vial.tooltip:
Right click on food/drink trays to use
Clears all poison applied to trays
item.noellesroles.delusion_vial.tooltip:
Right click on food/drink trays to use
Creates fakes poison, making the consumer of the poisoned item
think they are poisoned, but have no physical effect.
item.noellesroles.role_mine.tooltip:
Right click to Place down on Floors or Ceilings.
Invisible to other players, both placed and in hand.
Detonates after 5 seconds.
Simulates the sound of a gunshot.
item.noellesroles.modifier_stealer.toolt:
Use on a non-vultured body to steal their modifier.
Single use, 10s cooldown
Blacklisted Modifiers: Tiny, Bellringer
